text.en: This is the SEE Grade Increment 2081 (2025 AD) question paper for Computer Science, Optional Second subject, paper code GI-3031. It carries full marks of 50 and an allotted time of 2 hours, divided into Group A (short, one-line answers and terminology), Group B (short/medium answers including QBASIC program tracing and debugging), and Group C (numerical conversions and full program-writing questions in QBASIC and C).

items.code:
DECLARE SUB Result (A$)
A$="Development"
CALL Result (A$)
END

SUB Result (A$)
FOR C=1 TO LEN(A$) STEP 2
  X$=MID$(A$,C,1)
  PRINT X$
NEXT C
END SUB

WEND
CLOSE
END
